jobs.name: mountains
jobs.prompt: Original production sprite sheet for a dark fantasy illustrated regional map, muted Elden Ring parchment palette, Tolkien cartographic relief, fine pixel-cluster engraved hatching, consistent light from upper-left and slightly elevated north-facing cartographic view. TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 separate sprites in equal cells, left-to-right top-to-bottom. Every full silhouette strictly inside middle 70% of its cell; at least 15% completely transparent margins on ALL FOUR sides. No touching adjacent cells, NO grid lines, NO text, NO checkerboard painted into image. Fine source art reduced into a pixel game later. Ground feet scatter into fine gravel and sparse grass with alpha, no rectangular base or tiny landscape framed scene. Coherent scale. SUBJECT: genuine interconnected high mountain range sections. Sharp irregular serrated skyline, visibly angular tall summits, folded ridge crest linking summits, connected angular rock shoulders. NOT low terraces or round hills, NOT rows of isolated identical triangular icons. Reddish grey umber stone, charcoal shadow faces, dusty rose/cream lit facets, sparse pale snow only at tallest sharp crests. 12 pieces: (1) long spine joining four tall jagged summits, (2) winding three-summit spine, (3) branching Y-ridge three summits, (4) low saddle between two tall summits, (5) tapering ridge ending at one tall summit, (6) stepped buttress connecting to high ridge, (7) curved high ridge with two unequal summits, (8) scree apron with a low rocky spur, (9) folded rocky valley between high shoulders, (10) foothill chain of three low angular spurs, (11) dramatic three-crag massif with coherent ridge, (12) fractured low cliff ledge. Sections 1,2,3,5,7,11 share a midheight ridge at left and right edges of their silhouette so they can overlap into long chains. Tall summits take at least half of silhouette height. Keep all 12 pieces separate, with generous completely empty margins.

jobs.prompt: Original production sprite sheet for a dark fantasy illustrated regional map, muted Elden Ring parchment palette, Tolkien cartographic relief, fine pixel-cluster engraved hatching, consistent light from upper-left and slightly elevated north-facing cartographic view. Grey blue peat, desaturated teal, pale grey dead trunks and muted golden brown rushes, crisp dark shadow details. Clearly distinct from green forest. Keep all 12 pieces fully separated with generous empty margins.
